title: Juicy Spanish Chicken Paella Valenciana
description: A buttery and juicy Spanish dish featuring chicken, vegetables, and saffron, perfect for a brunch mood, this paella valenciana recipe is a classic and flavorful one pan meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the butter in a large paella pan or skillet over medium high heat.
Add the chicken to the pan and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic to the pan and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the smoked paprika, saffron threads, and cream of tartar to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the Arborio rice to the pan and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth to the pan and bring to a boil.
Cover the pan with aluminum foil and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
Stir in the frozen peas and carrots and cook until heated through.
Remove the pan from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
